CLM-ORDERS is 44531 under both keep-first and keep-last deduplication, so the order count cannot by itself detect a dedup-direction error; it is net revenue and the completion rates that separate the two rules, and those do follow keep-last.

No deterministic rule checks the prose caveats inside analysis/answers/*.json (caveats_declared reads only the claim register and questions_are_answered only checks presence), which is how a false description of the dedup rule in R02 passed gate_claims_machine.
